summary: One new native MSEWallExclusion module solves minimum nominal pile-face setbacks and presents dimensioned exclusion boxes for both end bents; the project index gains one link.

LayoutClear: minimum rounded upward to RoundStep, inches

Bent1/Bent2 row bounds, current wall setbacks and encroachment status
